title: Ayurveda Myths Busted | Doshas, Texts & Pseudoscience
description:
Is Ayurveda really ancient wisdom or just pseudoscience wrapped in tradition? In this episode of Pale Blue Thoughts, we investigate the claims, origins, and practices of Ayurveda — exposing why much of it doesn’t stand up to modern science.

We break down:
Why Ayurveda is not 5000 years old but at most ~2000 years old.
The three doshas (Vata, Pitta, Kapha) and why they’re as unscientific as “vital force.”
The bizarre anatomy in texts like Sushruta Samhita and Charaka Samhita (360 bones, sperm + menstrual blood fusion, breast milk as transformed blood).
Strange and dangerous treatments: opium, cannabis, heavy metals, urine, feces, semen, tar, and string ligatures.
Why Ayurveda still clings to vitalism, long discarded by modern science.
How pseudoscience is repackaged as “holistic healing” while ignoring evidence-based medicine.

If you’ve searched for Ayurveda truth, Ayurveda myths, Sushruta Samhita explained, Charaka Samhita debunked, Ayurveda vs science, Ayurveda pseudoscience, this video gives you the rational perspective.

👉 Don’t forget to like, comment, share, and subscribe to support evidence-based science over pseudoscience!
